what: Archetype voter labels are mapped only for diagnostics, not retry launch
scenario_or_breakage: When cursor-validity, cursor-plan-fidelity, or cursor-pragmatism emits narrative output, parse-rate-retry passes that label into launch_voter_retry; the current launcher only accepts bare cursor and returns unknown voter retry tool, so the required same-archetype retry never runs
suggested_fix: Normalize cursor-* labels to launch tool cursor inside launch_voter_retry or a shared helper, while preserving the archetype label for diagnostics and timing; add a retry-path test for one cursor-* label
